schema.content:
Table "Addresses" {
  "address_id" INTEGER [pk]
  "line_1_number_building" TEXT
  "town_city" TEXT
  "zip_postcode" TEXT
  "state_province_county" TEXT
  "country" TEXT
}

Table "Forms" {
  "form_id" INTEGER [pk]
  "form_type_code" TEXT [not null]
  "service_id" INTEGER
  "form_number" TEXT
  "form_name" TEXT
  "form_description" TEXT
}

Table "Individuals" {
  "individual_id" INTEGER [pk]
  "individual_first_name" TEXT
  "individual_middle_name" TEXT
  "inidividual_phone" TEXT
  "individual_email" TEXT
  "individual_address" TEXT
  "individual_last_name" TEXT
}

Table "Organization_Contact_Individuals" {
  "individual_id" INTEGER [pk, not null]
  "organization_id" INTEGER [pk, not null]
  "date_contact_from" TIMESTAMP [not null]
  "date_contact_to" TIMESTAMP
}

Table "Organizations" {
  "organization_id" INTEGER [pk]
  "date_formed" TIMESTAMP
  "organization_name" TEXT
  "uk_vat_number" TEXT
}

Table "Parties" {
  "party_id" INTEGER [pk]
  "payment_method_code" TEXT [not null]
  "party_phone" TEXT
  "party_email" TEXT
}

Table "Party_Addresses" {
  "party_id" INTEGER [pk, not null]
  "address_id" INTEGER [pk, not null]
  "date_address_from" TIMESTAMP [not null]
  "address_type_code" TEXT [not null]
  "date_address_to" TIMESTAMP
}

Table "Party_Forms" {
  "party_id" INTEGER [pk, not null]
  "form_id" INTEGER [pk, not null]
  "date_completion_started" TIMESTAMP [not null]
  "form_status_code" TEXT [not null]
  "date_fully_completed" TIMESTAMP
}

Table "Party_Services" {
  "booking_id" INTEGER [not null]
  "customer_id" INTEGER [not null]
  "service_id" INTEGER [not null]
  "service_datetime" TIMESTAMP [not null]
  "booking_made_date" TIMESTAMP
}

Table "Services" {
  "service_id" INTEGER [pk]
  "service_type_code" TEXT [not null]
  "service_name" TEXT
  "service_descriptio" TEXT
}



Ref: "Forms"."service_id" > "Services"."service_id"

Ref: "Organization_Contact_Individuals"."individual_id" > "Individuals"."individual_id"

Ref: "Organization_Contact_Individuals"."organization_id" > "Organizations"."organization_id"

Ref: "Party_Addresses"."party_id" > "Parties"."party_id"

Ref: "Party_Addresses"."address_id" > "Addresses"."address_id"

Ref: "Party_Forms"."form_id" > "Forms"."form_id"

Ref: "Party_Forms"."party_id" > "Parties"."party_id"

Ref: "Party_Services"."customer_id" > "Parties"."party_id"

Ref: "Party_Services"."service_id" > "Services"."service_id"
